name: Sensory Prediction Error Circuit
short_description: Compares expected sensory states against actual inputs, weighted by precision estimates, to generate prediction error signals that drive model updates.

components.name: PREDICTION_GENERATOR
components.description: Generates predictions of forthcoming sensory states based on internal models

components.name: SENSORY_COMPARATOR
components.description: Computes mismatch between predicted and actual sensory input

components.name: PRECISION_ESTIMATOR
components.description: Estimates reliability of sensory channels and weightings

components.name: PE_WEIGHTER
components.description: Weights prediction error by precision to generate learning signal

key_references: Rao, R. P., & Ballard, D. H. (1999). Predictive coding in the visual cortex: A functional interpretation of some extra-classical receptive-field effects. Nature Neuroscience, 2(1), 79–87.
Clark, A. (2013). Whatever next? Predictive brains, situated agents, and the future of cognitive science. Behavioral and Brain Sciences, 36(3), 181–204.
design_implications: Predictable, coherent sensory environments reduce prediction error and cognitive load; use consistent signage, wayfinding, and spatial organization
Novel or surprising elements generate prediction errors that capture attention; use novelty strategically in engagement-critical spaces
